description: This file defines a builder class for creating an immutable 'Thing' object from scratch. It provides methods to set various attributes, features, lifecycle information, permissions, and metadata for a 'Thing'. The class is used to construct complex 'Thing' instances with a fluent API, managing internal state through various builder components.

classes.name: ImmutableThingFromScratchBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for constructing immutable 'Thing' objects with customizable attributes, features, lifecycle state, permissions, and metadata in a thread-unsafe manner.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of ImmutableThingFromScratchBuilder.

methods.name: setAttributes
methods.description: Sets multiple attributes using an Attributes object or JSON representations.

methods.name: setNullAttributes
methods.description: Sets attributes to a null state.

methods.name: setEmptyAttributes
methods.description: Sets attributes to an empty state.

methods.name: setAttribute
methods.description: Sets a single attribute at the specified JSON pointer path.

methods.name: removeAttribute
methods.description: Removes an attribute at the specified JSON pointer path.

methods.name: setDefinition
methods.description: Sets the 'ThingDefinition' of the 'Thing'.

methods.name: setNullDefinition
methods.description: Sets the 'ThingDefinition' to a null value.

methods.name: removeDefinition
methods.description: Removes the current 'ThingDefinition'.

methods.name: setFeature
methods.description: Sets a feature by Feature object or by feature ID and related parameters.

methods.name: removeFeature
methods.description: Removes a feature by its ID.

methods.name: setFeatureDefinition
methods.description: Sets the definition of a specific feature.

methods.name: removeFeatureDefinition
methods.description: Removes the definition of a feature.

methods.name: setFeatureProperty
methods.description: Sets a property of a feature.

methods.name: removeFeatureProperty
methods.description: Removes a property from a feature.

methods.name: setFeatures
methods.description: Sets multiple features either from an iterable or JSON.

methods.name: removeAllFeatures
methods.description: Removes all features.

methods.name: setLifecycle
methods.description: Sets the lifecycle state.

methods.name: setRevision
methods.description: Sets the revision either from a revision object or a revision number.

methods.name: setModified
methods.description: Sets the Modified timestamp.

methods.name: setCreated
methods.description: Sets the Created timestamp.

methods.name: setMetadata
methods.description: Associates Metadata with the 'Thing'.

methods.name: setPolicyId
methods.description: Associates a PolicyId with the 'Thing'.

methods.name: removePolicyId
methods.description: Removes the associated PolicyId.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the 'ThingId' for the 'Thing'.

methods.name: setGeneratedId
methods.description: Generates and sets a random 'ThingId'.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs and returns an immutable 'Thing' based on current builder state.
